summary: Runtime consumer for the already-integrated Groink shell-strike bridge: port the parked Groink policy/arena/target/volley stack into the current draft, build it into pikmin_pc, and demonstrate shell -> proxy-receiver hits/death in real GL through p2_groink_apply_strike with the capacity-correct tracker.

1a7702fbfb165203667bc4f7bc0e79c98e970287 honour PIKMIN_P2_ROOM_WINDOW in the Groink runtime fixture

preserved_integrated_bridge.note: pc_port/pc_p2_groink_hit.{h,cpp} and pc_port/pc_p2_groink_strike.{h,cpp} are unchanged from the base and byte-identical to the draft 5f33a9e6 working copies; the capacity-correct P2GroinkStrikeTracker (Apply/AlreadyHit/RejectedAtCapacity, kMaxTracked=64) is preserved.

ported_from_parked_candidate.note: All 13 files are byte-identical to the earlier draft integration-lead working copies; no source edits were required to compile against 5f33a9e6.

reconciliation.cmake: Added pc_p2_groink.cpp, arena, attack, map_trace, target and volley to PC_PORT_SOURCES and registered the seven standalone pure-policy CTests (p2_groink_test, _attack, _clock, _events, _target, _volley, _hit).
reconciliation.fixture_consumer: tools/p2_groink_target_runtime.cpp no longer #includes pc_p2_groink_volley/attack/target/hit/strike and pc_p2_projectile_receiver .cpp; it includes only their headers and resolves the implementations from the linked pikmin_pc objects, removing duplicate-definition risk now that the stack is in the product.
reconciliation.window_override: The fixture main now parses PIKMIN_P2_ROOM_WINDOW=WxH and passes it to pc_window_init (pc_window_init itself does not consult the variable).

standalone_tests.result: all eight compile and exit 0: p2_groink_test (no output), p2_groink_attack_test PASS, p2_groink_clock_test PASS, p2_groink_events_test PASS, p2_groink_target_test PASS, p2_groink_volley_test PASS, p2_groink_hit_test PASS, p2_groink_strike_test PASS (capacity-correct tracker regression included)

honest_limits: The strikes that reach the receiver use a fixture-pinned Navi placement at the terminal sweep midpoint (P2_GROINK_STRIKE_PLACEMENT fixture_pinned=1), not natural pursuit; the moving in-flight sweep executes every tick (90 steps) but produced no natural moving hit (hits=0 wind=0).
Real MiniHoudai actor registration/locomotion remains blocked on the shared teki.h / tekimgr.cpp / gameCoreSection.cpp hook; this is still a host-owned proxy with a wildcard sink.

The proxy receiver marker strings are P2_GROINK_RECEIVER_HIT / P2_GROINK_RECEIVER_DEAD; the seam's P2_PROJECTILE_RECEIVER_HIT / P2_PROJECTILE_RECEIVER_DEAD strings are emitted only by the projectiles-arena consumer, not this Groink fixture.
Wind impulse is carried in the bridge result and logged in the standalone/unit paths but lane 20's receiver still has no impulse/knockback representation.
No maintained checkout or shared build was modified; native origin/upstream not pushed.
